games.name: Feed A Black Hole
games.desc:
🌌A Game About Feeding a Black Hole 🌌

Your mission is simple… feed the black hole.

Throw objects into the black hole to grow its power, earn money, and unlock powerful upgrades. The more you feed it, the stronger it becomes. But beware — the universe has limits, and only the best feeders will reach the ultimate black hole.

💰 Earn Cash – Feed items into the black hole to generate money.
⚡ Buy Upgrades – Increase gravity, size, and feeding speed.
🌍 Unlock New Areas – Discover new objects to consume.
📈 Progress Faster – Upgrade your black hole to insane levels.
🏆 Climb the Leaderboards – Become the strongest black hole feeder.

Will your black hole become the ultimate cosmic force… or collapse trying?

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support development!
🔔 More updates and upgrades coming soon!*
